remarks: Behind private gates on more than an acre, this exceptional estate captures the timeless appeal of one of Malibu's most sought-after neighborhoods, where understated architecture, expansive grounds, and effortless indoor-outdoor living come together in perfect balance. The property comprises an approximately 6,300-square-foot single-level main residence with five bedrooms and five-and-a-half baths, complemented by a detached 1,000-square-foot guest house. Completing the offering is a coveted key to Riviera III beach access at Little Dume, granting entry to one of Malibu's most exclusive and secluded stretches of coastline.
